IC1: Males [OR] and females aged between 18 to 75 years.
IC2: Adult patient under guardianship with consent obtained and the legal guardian's authorisation obtained.
IC3: Single stroke having occurred more than 6 months before (previous TIA is accepted).
IC4: Capable of understanding instructions and participating in the definition of a therapeutic goal (Boston Diagnostic Aphasia Examination (BDAE) < 3).
IC5: Having previously undergone BTI. The last injection must have been performed at least 4 months prior to inclusion.
IC6: Affiliation to the French social security regime or a similar regime.
IC7: Patient (or the legal guardian if under guardian adult patient) has signed the informed consent form.
